notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Forest Lookouts Arp page carries only a header (Smith County, Texas Forest Service) with no history, design or height, so the story is shorter than the usual target by design. No source read gives a build date, staffing, fire history or current access. The 'Standing' status is from the FFLA Texas list, which is undated. A search turned up the Arp Volunteer Fire Department (smithcountyfire.org), a different organization, which was not used. A tnlandforms.us list includes 'arp' with a TFS flag, but its column meaning is not explained on the page, so it was not used. A human could check Texas Forest Service records or a local Smith County history for the tower's build date and current status.
